title: Step 5 clicked the still-rendered 'Play Unit — Soaring Scout to base' button, but the result was Petal Pixie (from the step-4 click) landing in base and energy 2→0; the Soaring Scout play was then sent anyway and bounced by the server a step later with an opaque toast 'Move rejected: Move 'playUnit' condition not met' (visible only in 06.png). The action panel kept advertising both 2-cost plays at
expected: Trace matches: step 04 snapshot (taken after the Petal Pixie click) still lists both playUnit moves at energy 2 with empty base; step 05 (click Soaring Scout) yields base=[Petal Pixie], energy 0; 06.png shows toast "Move rejected: Move 'playUnit' condition not met" (text from packages/core/src/engine/rule-engine.ts:833, surfaced verbatim by websocket.js:148 showToast(`Move rejected: ${msg.error}`)). Source confirms no in-flight guard on action buttons: render/actions.js:340-345 renders playUnit buttons with onclick='executeMove(...)' directly, and executeMove (game-flow.js:3-27) just ws.send()s with no disable/in-flight state. The only in-flight latch, window.__rbTurnActionInFlight, is checked/set solely in init.js:31-40 (Space key) and hotkeys.js:266-268, and cleared in websocket.js:94/123/138 — never consulted by action-panel clicks. Engine behavior is rules-correct; defect is UI staleness + opaque rejection message.
rule: Soaring Scout (ogn-216-298) / Petal Pixie (unl-076-219); cost payment rule 356 (can't play without paying full cost)
